segments.he:
הַקְדָּמָה — אות א — חַיִּים שֶׁזָּכָה
<אֲבָל הַחַיִּים שֶׁזָּכָה הוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה, עֲדַיִן לֹא טָעַם שׁוּם אָדָם בָּעוֹלָם>
segments.en: Context: "But the life that he — of blessed memory — merited, no person in the world has ever yet tasted."

segments.he:
סימן לח (38) — עַזּוּת
<the second tzaddik has more brazenness/forwardness>
segments.en: Art 38: inline in article about the two tzaddikim.

segments.he:
סימן נא (51) — עֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת
<Asarah Maamaros>
segments.en: Art 51: book name inserted inline.

segments.he:
סימן סט (69) — אַל דָּמִי לָךְ
Already translated in article body (witticism about Elokim al domi lach)

סימן פ (80) — פְּרִי
Full story: woman in Medvedivkeh, unripe plums, occasioned LM I:257 and LM II:88

סימן פד (84) — חֲלוֹם
Dream of Yom Kippur sacrifice — "I fear for what is yet to come"

סימן פו (86) — הַמְפֻרְסָם שֶׁל עַכְשָׁו
Full Shabbos 5564 story — strange dream, garment, old man rebukes, BST "chose to be close"

סימן צב (92) — לֶאֱכֹל הַרְבֵּה / מַעֲשֶׂה הַזֹּאת / אֶחָד מֵהַבַּרְחָנִים
Three hashmatos: eating for three men; Third Meal BST appeared; verse about feeding the animal-body

סימן צג (93) — שֵׁשׁ בָּתֵּי כְנֶסִיּוֹת
Six synagogues he knew and forgot — names specified inline

סימן קא (101) — אַחַר הִסְתַּלְּקוּתוֹ
Full story of Rabbi Hirsh of Medvedivkeh — only son dying, "I will be your Kaddish", oath b'nekitas chefetz, came immediately after sealing of grave

סימן קיג (113) — רַבִּי יוֹסֵף
<Rabbi Yoske the son of> the Gaon Rabbi Avraham Dov of Chmelnik
segments.en: Correction: Adil married Rabbi Yoske the SON OF the Gaon, not the Gaon himself.

segments.he:
סימן קיז (117) — פַּאנְצֶ'ערְלֶע — מִרְיָם
End of article: "How great she is... who knows what will become of Miriam." See Hosafos §12.

סימן קכא (121) — הַבַּעַל שֵׁם טוֹב
<for if the Baal Shem Tov of blessed memory was, it would also search more.>
segments.en: ...the world longs for when there will be like the Baal Shem Tov of blessed memory — <for if the Baal Shem Tov of blessed memory was, it would also search more.>

segments.he:
סימן קכג (123) — הַזָּקֵן / חִדּוּשׁ כָּזֶה / תַּנָּאִים
Major hashmata block: letter identifying Zeide of Shpole; famous meeting; fly/spider; "I have such an enemy..."; <and his forces>; <And afterwards he said this is the explanation of "And I shall see my enemies"...>

סימן קמ (140) — חִדּוּשׁ כָּזֶה
<exceedingly extraordinary — the like of which never existed even in the previous generations>
segments.en: ...Rabbainu o.b.m. was a wondrous novelty <exceedingly extraordinary...previous generations>

segments.he:
סימן קמא (141) — תַּנָּאִים וַאֲמוֹרָאִים
<it seems that he said then that he merited what the Tanna'im and Amora'im did not merit, and one thing he revealed to the man of his household, and they need to ask him yet several more matters that he heard from his holy mouth.>
segments.en: ...he did not wish to reveal it. And one thing he revealed to the man of his household — <it seems...holy mouth.>

segments.he:
סימן קמו (146) — אֶרְאֶה בְשׂוֹנְאַי
<And afterwards he said: this is the explanation of "And I shall see my enemies"... "give me eyes so that I can see my enemy — how he stands now... and through this I will know clearly my own level.">
segments.en: Added as entire final paragraph of art 146.

segments.he:
סימן קנא (151) — הַתּוֹרָה
<that is, he desired that Hashem Yisburach return and say to him the Torah as He did before Moshe Rabbainu upon him be peace>
segments.en: ...he had desired to accomplish a matter before Hashem Yisburach — <that is, he desired...> — and he had many arguments for this.

segments.he:
סימן קסב (162) — פַּאנְצֶ'עַר-א
<And this will be very difficult to fulfill (see Likutay Halchos, Yoreh Deah, Laws of the Worm, §4)>
segments.en: Art 162 hashmata closes with this reference at the end of the article.

segments.he:
סימן קפט (189) — הָעִיר וְקַדִּישׁ
<that even the Watcher and Holy One [ir v'kaddish] also needs to receive from there, like a bird that drinks from the flowing spring>
segments.en: ...such that even the holy watcher <that even the Watcher and Holy One...flowing spring>

segments.he:
סימן רנד (254) — שִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים
<I heard in his name that he said that he will learn Torah together with [all] the Seven Shepherds [and it is already cited in the words of Rabbainu z"l several times that he is in the aspect of Mashiach — but that the generation is not worthy of this]>

סימן רסג (263) — שָׂרָה וּמִרְיָם
<his daughter the bride Moras Sarah and his young daughter Moras Miriam>
segments.en: ...And he commanded that they bring him <his daughter the bride Moras Sarah and his young daughter Moras Miriam> and he danced with them greatly.

segments.he:
סימן רסה (265) — אוֹרִי
<אוֹרִי [my light]>
segments.en: ...How does one take money for revealing <אוֹרִי [my light]> — that in the revealed it is easier to innovate than in the hidden.

segments.he:
סימן רפא (281) — מֶלֶךְ וְכֶבֶשׂ
<And immediately when it fell on the tower, immediately they all fell before him and said: "Long live the King! Long live the King!">
segments.en: ...And this precious stone was one of charm [chen]. <And immediately when it fell...Long live the King!>

segments.he:
סימן רפה (285) — הָרַב שָׁלוֹם
<In any case [min ha-stam], wherever there would be a chevra — he would certainly be their Rebbe! [Yiddish: "min ha-stam vey, sigivalт givven a chevra volt ich givven zeyer Rebbe"]>

סימן רפז (287) — מֶלֶךְ יִכְבַּשׁ
<He said: "[There is no need to say] which king will conquer — this I know for certain. And moreover I know what another tzaddik does not know [that all the heavenly beings do not know].>

סימן רפט (289) — אַף אֶחָד
<that afterwards not one person said a Torah discourse from there>

סימן רצג (293) — יִשְׂרָאֵל
<About every single one of our people [and about every single one of my people He will say] — Hashem Yisburach says: "Israel in whom I am glorified" [Isaiah 49].>

סימן שב (302) — הַחִלּוּק בֵּינוֹ וּבֵינֵיהֶם
<That once one of our people spoke of the greatness of the famous Rabbi Shalom of Porobisht with Rabbainu z"l... "In the Future to Come they will see the difference between him and them.">

סימן שט (309) — לְאַחַר פְּטִירָתוֹ
<that one can come after his passing and swear on this while holding an object. And I did not hear this from him directly — only from the mouth of our people I heard it in his holy name.>

סימן שיב (312) — הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁבַּמְפֻרְסָמִים
<what has not been done with the greatest of today's famous ones.>

סימן שכד (324) — אַנְסֶה אֶת עַצְמִי
<I heard when he drew me close [when I drew close to him], that it is very difficult etc. because of the master of thought [the evil inclination in thought], which is one of the twenty-four things that impede repentance (see Rambam, Laws of Repentance, chapter 4) — but even so, I will try myself.>

סימן של (330) — כִּמְדֻמֶּה ר' שִׁמְעוֹן
TWO HASHMATOS:
[it seems this was Rabbi Shimon his servant]
<but I without you also cannot do anything at all>
segments.en: Art 330 also completed from truncation — full story of R' Shimon requesting great awe.

segments.he:
סימן שלב (332) — נְהַר הַמִּטַּהֵר
<Said the transcriber: Once he praised himself and said it in a manner of pleasantry: [Yiddish: "Vert zich on ein mir mit a finger, vet zich shoin mit zibn vassern"] — "Touch yourself with one finger from me and you will already be purified with seven rivers.">

סימן שלד (334) — מָרָה שְׁחוֹרָה
<that is, this one who fell into black melancholy — it seemed to him that he was going to die>
segments.en: ...this man's mind became somewhat confused <that is, this one who fell into black melancholy...going to die>. And he will bring him to merit.

segments.he:
סימן שמ (340) — אֲנִי אָשִׁיר שִׁיר
<Afterwards I heard in his name that he said on Rosh Hashana: "I have a melody to sing in the Future to Come — this will be the World to Come of all the tzaddikim and the chassidim."> See Torah "Tiku Tochecha" [LM Tinyana 8] and the Tale of the Seven Beggars.

סימן שמב (342) — מִכָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁאֲנִי רוֹצֶה
<I can begin from any place I wish — and understand the matter.>
segments.en: ...But <I can begin from any place I wish — and understand the matter.>

segments.he:
סימן שמט (349) — לִקְנוֹת הַסֵּפֶר
<And whoever does not have the means to buy — let him sell all the books he has and buy this book of his. And whoever has no books to sell — let him sell the pillow from under his head and buy his book.>

סימן שסג (363) — מְקוֹם שֶׁלֹּא קִבֵּל
<And he said that he receives Torah from a place from which no person in the world has yet received Torah.>

סימן שסב (362) — כְּלָלִיּוּת
<הַתּוֹרוֹת שֶׁנִּכְתְּבוּ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ הַקָּדוֹשָׁה בְּעַצְמוֹ אָסוּר שֶׁיְּכוֹלִים לְדַקְדֵּק בָּהֶם כְּמוֹ בַּמִּקְרָא... גַּם אָמַר שֶׁהַתּוֹרוֹת שֶׁנִּכְתְּבוּ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּעַצְמוֹ מְסֻגָּל כִּי הוּא כְּלָלִיּוּת>
segments.en: ...and they are all the secret of the intention of Tefillin. And in particular <the Torahs written in his own holy language — one must not scrutinize them as with Scripture, for there are many intentions there... and he also said that the Torahs written in his own holy language are propitious for they are comprehensive>. And the essence is the moral instruction...

segments.he:
סימן שסה (365) — הַסּוֹמֵךְ
<כְּמוֹ שֶׁסּוֹמְכִין עַל אֵיזֶה דָּבָר, שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי הַסּוֹמֵךְ גָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר מִן הַנִּסְמָךְ>
segments.en: ...their holy words are also included within it, like one who leans on something — <for certainly the one who leans is greater than that which is leaned upon>:

segments.he:
סימן שעב (372) — לְפַרְצוּף
<לְפַרְצוּף כָּל הָעוֹלָמוֹת>
segments.en: Very end of article: ...the human form alludes to what it alludes <to the partzuf of all the worlds>:

segments.he:
סימן שפא (381) — זְקֵנִי ר' נַחְמָן
<שַׁיָּךְ לְהַסִּפּוּר הַמּוּבָא בְּשִׂיחוֹת הָרַ"ן, אוֹת ריא... אִם הָיָה זְקֵנִי ר' נַחְמָן שׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹרָתִי, הָיָה אֶצְלוֹ גַּם-כֵּן חִדּוּשׁ. וְאַחַר-כָּךְ סִיֵּם אִם הָיָה הַבַּעַל-שֵׁם-טוֹב שׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹרָתִי הָיָה אֶצְלוֹ גַּם-כֵּן חִדּוּשׁ, אִם הָיָה רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בַּר יוֹחַאי שׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹרָתִי הָיָה גַּם-כֵּן חִדּוּשׁ גַּם אָז>
segments.en: Entire sub-section 43 is the hashmata — if my grandfather Rabbi Nachman / BST / Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai were to hear my Torah — it would also be a novelty for them even then.

segments.he:
סימן שפד (384) — סוּס
<הָיִיתִי סְבוּר שֶׁתָּבִיא לִי סוּס בְּעַד הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁלִּי. וְסִפֵּר מִזֶּה בְּלֵיל שַׁבָּת, שֶׁחָפֵץ בְּסוּס מִבְחָר עִם זִינְטִיל (אֻכָּף) טוֹב וּמִבְחָר, אַף-עַל-פִּי שֶׁכָּתוּב "שֶׁקֶר הַסוּס לִתְשׁוּעָה", אַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן "מוּכָן לְמִלְחָמָה, וְלַה' הַתְּשׁוּעָה">
segments.en: Goes before "Not to mention a word" in sub-section 46: <I thought you would bring me a horse in exchange for my Torah. And he told of this on Shabbos night — that he desired a choice horse with a good and choice saddle, even though it says "The horse is a vain hope for salvation" — even so "Ready for battle, and salvation is G-d's.">

segments.he:
סימן שצא (391) — בֵּאוּר הַלִּקּוּטִים
<הוֹסָפָה מִסֵּפֶר 'בֵּאוּר הַלִּקּוּטִים', מִמּוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב אַבְרָהָם בֶּן רַבִּי נַחְמָן זצ"ל (סוֹף סִימָן רפ"ב): "כַּיּוֹם, כַּאֲשֶׁר הַסֵּפֶר שֶׁלִּי כְּבָר יָדוּעַ וְנָפוֹץ בָּעוֹלָם, מְחֻיָּבִים לִלְמֹד אַךְ וְרַק בַּסֵּפֶר שֶׁלִּי!">
segments.en: Last paragraph of art 391 — addition from Be'ur HaLikutim by our teacher Rabbi Avraham ben Rabbi Nachman z"l: today, when my book is already known and spread in the world, one is obligated to learn exclusively in my book!

segments.he:
סימן שצב (392) — דֶּרֶךְ חָדָשׁ
<שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא הָלַךְ בּוֹ אָדָם מֵעוֹלָם, וְגַם הַבַּעַל-שֵׁם-טוֹב לֹא, וְשׁוּם בְּרִיָּה לֹא מִזְּמַן קַבָּלַת הַתּוֹרָה>
segments.en: ...I am walking on a completely new path <that no person has ever yet walked, and also not the Baal Shem Tov, and no creature since the time of the giving of the Torah>

segments.he:
סימן שצט (399) — גְּרַאם / שִׁוִּיתִי
TWO HASHMATOS:
<מִתְנַהֵג עַל פִּי זֶה> — inline: "for the entire world <is conducted according to this>"
<אָמַר הַמַּעְתִּיק: "שִׁוִּיתִי ה' לְנֶגְדִי תָמִיד" בְּחִינַת מִתְנַגֵּד — אֲבָל לְמִתְנַגְדִי שֶׁלִּי אֵין שׁוּם עֵצָה רַק הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יִהְיֶה בְּעֶזְרִי לְהִנָּצֵל מִמֶּנּוּ>

סימן תב (402) — הַעֲלָמַת הָאוֹר
<אָמַר הַמַּעְתִּיק: לְעִנְיַן הַעֲלָמַת הָאוֹר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנִּפְלָא שֶׁל אַדְמוֹ"ר זַ"ל... יְהִי רָצוֹן שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה הָאֱמֶת בָּעוֹלָם וְיִתְפַּרְסֵם קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ, וְאָז תָּבוֹא הַגְּאֻלָּה בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ אָמֵן>
segments.en: Transcriber's note at end: on the concealment of his great and wondrous light — the grave hidden through controversy like Moshe's grave — may the truth be revealed and his holiness be known to the world, and then redemption will come speedily in our days, Amen.

segments.he:
סימן תז (407) — מוֹרֶה נְבוּכִים / רַמְבַּ"ם
TWO HASHMATOS:
<מִסֵּפֶר מוֹרֶה נְבוּכִים> — inline after "philosophical books"
<וְאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל שֶׁמַּה שֶּׁמּוּבָא בְּסֵפֶר הַגִּלְגּוּלִים שֶׁהָרַמְבַּ"ם הָיָה פְּאַת שְׂמֹאל שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ... הָיָה מִתְקוֹטֵט עִם הָרַמְבַּ"ם... "הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת מֵהַמְשֻׁלָּשׁ מְרֻבָּע"... וְאָסוּר לְהִכָּנֵס בַּחֲקִירוֹת כְּלָל>

סימן תט (409) — מְפֻרְסָמִים
<לִגְדוֹלִים מְפֻרְסָמִים, וּבִפְרָט סֵפֶר מוֹרֶה נְבוּכִים>
segments.en: ...works authored by certain great ones that the world considers <famous great ones — and in particular the book Moreh Nevuchim>, and he warned greatly not to look into them at all.

segments.he:
סימן תכד (424) — שַׁעֲרֵי גַן עֵדֶן / שְׁמִטּוֹת
<וְכָל פַּעַם שֶׁסִּפֵּר מֵעִנְיָן זֶה, לֹא הָיָה מַסְכִּים כְּלָל. וְהַסֵּפֶר שַׁעֲרֵי גַן עֵדֶן שֶׁיָּצָא מֵחָדָשׁ בְּיָמֵינוּ, הָיָה לְמַרְאֵה עֵינֵי רַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל וְלֹא הוּטַב בְּעֵינָיו... וְגַם דַּעַת הָאֲרִ"י זַ"ל אֵינוֹ מַסְכִּים כְּלָל לְעִנְיַן הַשְּׁמִטּוֹת>

סימן תנג (453) — גִימָאלְט זַיין

TWO HASHMATOS:
<מִסֵּפֶר מוֹרֶה נְבוּכִים> — inline after "philosophical books"
<וְאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל שֶׁמַּה שֶּׁמּוּבָא בְּסֵפֶר הַגִּלְגּוּלִים שֶׁהָרַמְבַּ"ם הָיָה פְּאַת שְׂמֹאל שֶׁל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּנוּ... הָיָה מִתְקוֹטֵט עִם הָרַמְבַּ"ם... "הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת מֵהַמְשֻׁלָּשׁ מְרֻבָּע"... וְאָסוּר לְהִכָּנֵס בַּחֲקִירוֹת כְּלָל>

סימן תט (409) — מְפֻרְסָמִים
<לִגְדוֹלִים מְפֻרְסָמִים, וּבִפְרָט סֵפֶר מוֹרֶה נְבוּכִים>
aligned_segments.en: ...works authored by certain great ones that the world considers <famous great ones — and in particular the book Moreh Nevuchim>, and he warned greatly not to look into them at all.

aligned_segments.he:
סימן תכד (424) — שַׁעֲרֵי גַן עֵדֶן / שְׁמִטּוֹת
<וְכָל פַּעַם שֶׁסִּפֵּר מֵעִנְיָן זֶה, לֹא הָיָה מַסְכִּים כְּלָל. וְהַסֵּפֶר שַׁעֲרֵי גַן עֵדֶן שֶׁיָּצָא מֵחָדָשׁ בְּיָמֵינוּ, הָיָה לְמַרְאֵה עֵינֵי רַבֵּנוּ זַ"ל וְלֹא הוּטַב בְּעֵינָיו... וְגַם דַּעַת הָאֲרִ"י זַ"ל אֵינוֹ מַסְכִּים כְּלָל לְעִנְיַן הַשְּׁמִטּוֹת>

סימן תנג (453) — גִימָאלְט זַיין
<אָמַר: (הָאט וִויא אִיר זֶעהט מִיךְ, קֶען גִימָאלְט זַיין) כְּמוֹ שֶׁאַתֶּם רוֹאִים אוֹתִי, יִתְכֵּן... אָמַר הַמַּעְתִּיק: רָצָה לוֹמַר שֶׁהָיָה מִתְיָרֵא וְחוֹשֵׁשׁ שֶׁלֹּא יָבוֹא לְמִכְשׁוֹל כָּזֶה שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ שׁוּם צַד תַּאֲוָה וַהֲנָאָה, אֲבָל לֹא חַ"ו שֶׁבָּא לִידֵי כָּךְ>

סימן תצא (491) — הַיָּמִים שֶׁהָיוּ לִי
<אַלּוּ הֵן הַיָּמִים שֶׁהָיוּ לִי: אֲדָר כ"ב, אִייָר ב' ט"ז, סִיוָן י"א י"ט, טֵבֵת ג' י"ט>
aligned_segments.en: At end of article — the list of special days that were his.
